Message.Name: Time Reference Message
Message.Description: The Time Reference message is used to provide a midnight reference point for recipients of the feed. It is sent whenever the system starts up and when the system crosses a midnight boundary.

Field.Name: Midnight Reference
Field.Description: Midnight Central Time reference time for subsequent Time messages, expressed as number of whole seconds since the Epoch (Midnight January 1, 1970 UTC).

Field.Name: Time Reference
Field.Description: Number of whole seconds from midnight Central Time.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Trade Date
Field.Description: Current Trade Date

Message.Name: Time Message
Message.Description: A Time message is immediately generated and sent when there is a PITCH event for a given clock second.

Field.Name: Time Reference
Field.Description: Number of whole seconds from midnight CentralTime.

Field.Name: Epoch Time
Field.Description: Number of whole seconds since the Epoch (Midnight January 1, 1970 UTC).

Message.Name: Unit Clear Message
Message.Description: The Unit Clear message instructs feed recipients to clear all orders for the CFE book in the unit specified in the Sequenced Unit Header message header.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Message.Name: Futures Instrument Definition Message
Message.Description: The Futures Instrument Definition message can be sent as a sequenced message or an un-sequenced message. It is sent as a sequenced message when the system starts up at the beginning of a trading session or an the instrument is created or modified during a trading day.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp or Unit Timestamp in this message if it is non-zero.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Six character, base 62 symbol.

Field.Name: Unit Timestamp
Field.Description: Unit timestamp expressed as number of whole seconds since the Epoch (Midnight, January 1, 1970 UTC).

Field.Name: Report Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol for product or underlying security.

Field.Name: Futures Flags
Field.Description: Value will always be zero indicating Standard Future.

Field.Name: Expiration Date
Field.Description: Expiration Date of Instrument.

Field.Name: Contract Size
Field.Description: Contract size of Instrument. Contract sizes less than 1 are represented with a 0 value; refer to the product specification for the contract size.

Field.Name: Listing State
Field.Description: Listing State Values

Field.Name: Price Increment
Field.Description: Minimum Price Increment.

Field.Name: Leg Count
Field.Description: Values greater than 0 indicate this is a spread instrument.

Field.Name: Leg Offset
Field.Description: Leg definitions, if any, begin at this offset from the beginning of the message. Possible values are 0 (no legs present) or 45 (spread instrument).

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved. Value will always be zero.

Field.Name: Contract Date
Field.Description: Populated for single leg instruments only. Zero-filled for spread instruments. The date that should be used in describing the future's third party symbol and the measurement period of the contract.

Field.Name: Future Leg
Field.Description: Future Leg

Message.Name: Futures Variance Symbol Mapping Message
Message.Description: The Futures Variance Symbol Mapping message is used to disseminate symbol reference data for S&P 500 Variance Futures (VA Futures) symbols.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp or Unit Timestamp in this message if it is non-zero.

Field.Name: Unit Timestamp
Field.Description: Unit timestamp expressed as number of whole seconds since the Epoch (Midnight, January 1, 1970 UTC).

Field.Name: Feed Symbol
Field.Description: Six character, base 62 symbol.

Field.Name: Futures Symbol
Field.Description: Twelve character textual definition of the symbol where the first six characters contain the product symbol, left justified, and padded on the right with spaces, and the right most six characters are the expiration date in YYMMDD format.

Field.Name: Accrued Day Variance
Field.Description: Accrued day variance as of the start of the trading day (signed 64-bit decimal with twelve implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Num Final Returns
Field.Description: Number of S&P 500 Index returns used in the Final Settlement Value calculation.

Field.Name: Num Elapsed Returns
Field.Description: Number of elapsed S&P 500 Index returns including the current day.

Message.Name: Price Limits Message
Message.Description: The Price Limits message is sent out at the start of a session for products subject to price limits per the contract specifications.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Six character, base 62 symbol.

Field.Name: Upper Price Limit
Field.Description: Upper price limit

Field.Name: Lower Price Limit
Field.Description: Lower price limit

Message.Name: Add Order Long Message
Message.Description: An Add Order message represents a newly accepted visible order on the CFE book.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Day-specific identifier assigned to this order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Side Indicator Values

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of contracts being added to the book (may be less than the number entered).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Six character, base 62 symbol.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The limit order price.

Message.Name: Add Order Short Message
Message.Description: An Add Order message represents a newly accepted visible order on the CFE book.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Day-specific identifier assigned to this order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Side Indicator Values

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of contracts being added to the book (may be less than the number entered).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Six character, base 62 symbol.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The limit order price.

Message.Name: Order Executed Message
Message.Description: Order Executed messages are sent when an order on the CFE book is executed in whole or in part.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that was executed.

Field.Name: Executed Quantity
Field.Description: Number of contracts executed.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: CFE generated day-unique execution identifier of this execution. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message.

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Trade Condition Values

Message.Name: Reduce Size Long Message
Message.Description: Reduce Size messages are sent when a visible order on the CFE book is partially reduced.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been reduced.

Field.Name: Canceled Quantity
Field.Description: Number of contracts canceled.

Message.Name: Reduce Size Short Message
Message.Description: Reduce Size messages are sent when a visible order on the CFE book is partially reduced.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been reduced.

Field.Name: Canceled Quantity
Field.Description: Number of contracts canceled.

Message.Name: Modify Order Long Message
Message.Description: The Modify Order message is sent whenever an open order is visibly modified. The Order Id refers to the Order Id of the original Add Order message.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been modified.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of contracts associated with this order after this modify (may be less than the number entered).

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The limit order price after this modify.

Message.Name: Modify Order Short Message
Message.Description: The Modify Order message is sent whenever an open order is visibly modified. The Order Id refers to the Order Id of the original Add Order message.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been modified.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of contracts associated with this order after this modify (may be less than the number entered).

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The limit order price after this modify.

Message.Name: Delete Order Message
Message.Description: The Delete Order message is sent whenever a booked order is cancelled or leaves the order book.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id a previously sent Add Order message that has been removed from order book.

Message.Name: Trade Long Message
Message.Description: The Trade message provides information about executions that occur off of the CFE book (such as ECRP/Block trades). Trade messages are necessary to calculate CFE execution data.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Obfuscated Order ID or Order Id of the executed order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Always B = Buy Order regardless of resting side.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Incremental number of contracts executed.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Six character, base 62 symbol.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The execution price of the order.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: CFE generated day-unique execution identifier of this trade. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message.

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Trade Condition Values

Message.Name: Trade Short Message
Message.Description: The Trade message provides information about executions that occur off of the CFE book (such as ECRP/Block trades). Trade messages are necessary to calculate CFE execution data.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Obfuscated Order ID or Order Id of the executed order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Always B = Buy Order regardless of resting side.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Incremental Number of contracts executed.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Six character, base 62 symbol.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The execution price of the order.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: CFE generated day-unique execution identifier of this trade. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message.

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Trade Condition Values

Message.Name: Transaction Begin Message
Message.Description: The Transaction Begin message indicates any subsequent messages, up to the accompanying Transaction End message, are all part of the same transaction block.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Message.Name: Transaction End Message
Message.Description: The Transaction End message indicates that a transaction indicated by a previous Transaction Begin message has completed.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Message.Name: Trade Break Message
Message.Description: The Trade Break message is sent whenever an execution on CFE is broken.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: CFE execution identifier of the execution that was broken. Execution Id refers to previously sent Order Executed or Trade message.

Message.Name: Settlement Message
Message.Description: Settlement messages are used to provide information concerning indicative, approved, or corrected daily and final settlement prices for CFE products.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Six character, base 62 symbol.

Field.Name: Trade Date
Field.Description: Trade Date for the settlement.

Field.Name: Settlement Price
Field.Description: Settlement Price

Field.Name: Issue
Field.Description: Issue Values

Message.Name: Open Interest Message
Message.Description: The Open Interest message is sent to communicate a symbol's open interest, usually for the prior trading date.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Six character, base 62 symbol.

Field.Name: Trade Date
Field.Description: Trade Date for the Open Interest data.

Field.Name: Open Interest
Field.Description: Open Interest for this symbol.

Message.Name: End Of Day Summary Message
Message.Description: The End of Day Summary message is sent immediately after trading ends for a symbol. No more Market Update messages will follow an End of Day Summary message for a particular symbol.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Six character, base 62 symbol.

Field.Name: Trade Date
Field.Description: Trade Date for the message.

Field.Name: Open Interest
Field.Description: Prior Trade Date Open Interest for this symbol.

Field.Name: High Price
Field.Description: The higher of highest bid price and highest trade price for the day. Block and ECRP trades (Trade Condition=B or E) do not update High Price.

Field.Name: Low Price
Field.Description: The lower of lowest offer price and lowest trade price for the day. Block and ECRP trades (Trade Condition=B or E) do not update Low Price.

Field.Name: Open Price
Field.Description: The first trade on the day (in any session) will set the Open Price for the day (valid only if Total Volume > 0). Block and ECRP trades (Trade Condition=B or E) do not update Open Price.

Field.Name: Close Price
Field.Description: The last trade on the day (in any session) will set the Close Price for the day (valid only if Total Volume > 0). Block and ECRP trades (Trade Condition=B or E) do not update Close Price.

Field.Name: Total Volume
Field.Description: Total number of contracts traded for the day, including block and ECRP trades.

Field.Name: Block Volume
Field.Description: Total number of block and derived contracts traded for the day.

Field.Name: ECRP Volume
Field.Description: Total number of contracts traded for the day.

Field.Name: Summary Flags
Field.Description: Summary Flags

Message.Name: Trading Status Message
Message.Description: The Trading Status message is used to indicate the current trading status of a Futures contract.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Six character, base 62 symbol.

Field.Name: Reserved1
Field.Description: Reserved

Field.Name: Trading Status
Field.Description: Trading Status Values

Field.Name: Reserved2
Field.Description: Reserved

Message.Name: End of Session Message
Message.Description: The End of Session message is sent for each unit when the unit shuts down. No more sequenced messages will be delivered for this unit, but heartbeats from the unit may be received.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Leg Ratio
Field.Description: Leg ratio (positive for buy, negative for sell).

Field.Name: Leg Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol of leg.

Field.Name: High Price Valid
Field.Description: Set if High Price is a valid value

Field.Name: High Price Is Bid
Field.Description: Set if High Price was set by the highest bid (rather than a trade)

Field.Name: Low Price Valid
Field.Description: Set if Low Price is a valid value

Field.Name: Low Price Is Offer
Field.Description: Set if Low Price was set by the lowest offer (rather than a trade)

Field.Name: Open Close Valid
Field.Description: Set if both Open Price and Close Price fields contain valid values

Field.Name: Reserved Flags
Field.Description: Reserved 5-7 Bits

Field.Name: Variance
Field.Description: Set for a Variance Future, clear for a Standard Future

Field.Name: Reserved Flags
Field.Description: Reserved 1-7 Bits
